images.caption: Figure 3:Scientific accomplishment and Research Closure across frontier models.(A)Mean Atomic Score and functional completion for Formulation (F), Output (O), Identification (I), and Mechanism (M). Atomic Scores are shown on the shared axis after multiplication by 10; functional completion is the mean attempt-level fraction of applicable criteria satisfied within each dimension.(B)Distribution of Research Closure levels across independent attempts. RC4 denotes complete closure, RC3 indicates that the main conclusion is supported, but material validation or scope gaps remain, and RC0–RC2 indicate different degrees of incomplete investigation.
